items.headline: Overcomes turnovers in win
items.text: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Extends TD streak despite season-low yardage
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.headline: Does little with 11 touches
items.text: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

items.headline: Records game-winning TD in victory
items.text: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Another 100-yard effort Sunday
items.text: Pickens secured seven of 10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Two TD catches in Week 11 win
items.text: Kelce brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: Clear top back against Bears
items.text: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.

items.headline: Only 15 total yards in Week 11
items.text: Black notched six carries for eight yards and secured his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 35-10 win versus the Vikings in Mexico City.

items.headline: Sidelined for first time in 2026
items.text: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

items.headline: Cleared of head injury
items.text: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.headline: Held in check by Chicago
items.text: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Handles five touches in defeat
items.text: Rodriguez rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. He added one catch for 13 yards on one target.

items.headline: Has thumb surgery, avoiding IR
items.text: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Struggles again in Week 11 loss
items.text: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Spectacular night in win
items.text: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.

items.headline: Leading receiver in loss to Jags
items.text: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

items.headline: Three catches during SNF
items.text: Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Eclipses century mark in win
items.text: Johnson rushed 23 times for 105 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 38 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: Finds end zone twice against Jets
items.text: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.

items.headline: First TD of career
items.text: Price posted nine carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory at Las Vegas.

items.headline: Struggles with accuracy in win
items.text: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.headline: Trending toward Week 12 return
items.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Strikes for three TDs in Week 11
items.text: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.

items.headline: Does little with 10 targets
items.text: Douglas caught two of 10 targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Six receptions in return
items.text: Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Four catches in Week 11 win
items.text: Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Makes three catches Sunday
items.text: Waddle secured three of six targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.

items.headline: Questionable for Monday
items.text: White (heel) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus the Bengals.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.

items.headline: Modest numbers in loss to Lions
items.text: Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to Detroit.

items.headline: Five total TDs for second straight week
items.text: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Churns out 69 rushing yards in loss
items.text: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Retains top job with Monangai back
items.text: Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards and caught both his targets for eight yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Leading receiver in tough Week 11 loss
items.text: Flowers caught eight of 11 targets for 97 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.

items.headline: Seven catches in Week 11 loss
items.text: Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Season-high yardage total in loss
items.text: Meyers brought in four of 10 targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.

items.headline: Keeps piling up TDs in win
items.text: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Efficient effort in win
items.text: Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Solid numbers in blowout loss
items.text: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Shut down by Minnesota
items.text: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

items.headline: Struggles in Week 10 loss
items.text: Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.

items.headline: Without clear timeline for return
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

items.headline: In concussion protocol
items.text: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Held in check by Giants
items.text: Tuten rushed 10 times for 33 yards and brought in all three targets for 20 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.

items.headline: Six catches in Week 11 win
items.text: Rice secured all six targets for 53 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: Totals 41 yards in Week 11 loss
items.text: Washington caught three of six targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He rushed two times for 11 yards.

items.headline: Just two grabs in loss to Panthers
items.text: Andrews caught two of three targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to Carolina.

items.headline: Quiet after first-quarter TD
items.text: Jones rushed eight times for 30 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Three catches in Week 11 win
items.text: Dell secured three of four targets for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Three TDs in 300-yard effort
items.text: Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: Dealing with apparent arm injury
items.text: Barkley (left arm) said after Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers that he believes he'll play in Thursday's game at Dallas, Johnny McGonigal of PennLive.com reports.

items.headline: One carry in victory
items.text: Dobbins rushed once for no gain during Sunday's 38-24 win over Las Vegas.

items.headline: Enters concussion protocol
items.text: Coker entered the league's concussion protocol following Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

items.headline: Scores TD on five catches
items.text: St. Brown brought in five of six targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Tops century mark in Week 11 loss
items.text: Olave caught nine of 15 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.

items.headline: Good yardage on one catch
items.text: Warren brought in one of five targets for 22 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

items.headline: Gets into end zone in upset win
items.text: Nabers brought in seven of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.headline: Comes up short against Giants
items.text: Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.

items.headline: Over 100 total yards in win
items.text: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Notches 100 total yards with TD
items.text: Hall rushed 20 times for 86 yards while catching all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.

items.headline: Second straight game with TD
items.text: Moore caught eight of 10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

items.headline: Gets 12 targets in return
items.text: Smith (hamstring) caught five of 12 targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.

items.headline: Splits workload in Week 11 loss
items.text: Allgeier carried the ball seven times for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.

items.headline: Two more TDs in Week 11 win
items.text: Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 24 yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Week 10 win
items.text: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Goes without catch in Week 11
items.text: Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.

items.headline: Highlight-reel TD in win over NO
items.text: Loveland caught all three of his targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Hits 100 scrimmage yards in loss
items.text: Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Just 141 passing yards in Week 11 win
items.text: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
